en.headline: Hong Kong men's epee team takes Asian Games bronze
en.dek: The side reached the semi-finals before losing to world champions Kazakhstan, securing a medal without a bronze-medal match.
body: Hong Kong's men's epee team claimed bronze at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Sunday after reaching the semi-finals and falling 34-45 to Kazakhstan.

The quartet of individual bronze medallist Fong Hoi-sun, Ng Ho-tin, Ho Wai-hang and Lau Ho-fung had earlier come from behind to beat Chinese Taipei 45-40 in the quarter-finals. There is no bronze-medal match in the team event, so a semi-final place already secured the medal.

It was the second successive Asian Games that Hong Kong had reached the last four in the men's team epee. Kazakhstan arrived as the world team champions from the championships held in Hong Kong two months earlier. Hong Kong's fencing team finished the Games with two silvers and four bronzes.

zh.headline: 亞運男子重劍團體港隊奪銅
zh.dek: 港隊晉級四強後不敵世界冠軍哈薩克，因不設季軍賽而鎖定銅牌。
body: 香港男子重劍團體周日在名古屋亞運四強以34比45不敵哈薩克，奪得銅牌。
方凱申、吳浩天、何瑋桁及劉昊峯早前在八強逆轉以45比40擊敗中華台北。團體賽不設季軍賽，晉級四強已確保獎牌。
這是港隊連續兩屆亞運打入男子重劍團體四強。哈薩克兩個月前在香港舉行的世界錦標賽奪得團體冠軍。港隊劍擊項目今屆共獲兩銀四銅。
